steps.text: Church of the Holy Family Newsletter

operator_notes: Bulletin is HTML on the article page — not a downloadable PDF.
Click the newest Holy Family Newsletter on /news/, then html step prints it.
skip_listing_nav=true prevents html_capture re-navigating away from the article.
do_not: Do not pin a fixed weekly URL — the slug changes every Sunday.
Do not remove skip_listing_nav — without it html_capture re-navigates away and prints a blank page.

Do not put the generic '#wpsp-24188 article:first-child' selector first — that widget also shows non-newsletter posts (e.g. a community press release), and first_match blindly clicks whatever is first without checking the title.
operator_notes_2026_08_09: 2026-08-09 fix: the widget's literal first post was a 'PRESS RELEASE' (Ardara/Sardinia twinning event), not the newsletter — first_match clicked it and harvested 0 mass-times content. Reordered so the href*='church-of-the-holy-family-newsletter' selector is tried first; the generic first-child selector is now only a last-resort fallback.

2026-08-09 fix: html_capture.py's CONTENT_SELECTORS also reordered globally (prefer .entry-content over generic article tag) — the theme's related-posts widget lives inside the same <article> wrapper as the real post body, so selecting 'article' first swept up an extra full newsletter and inflated the page count to 8 (over the 4-page limit) even for a genuinely short ~330-word notice.
